/us/bonus-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Bonuses are usually withheld at a flat 22% federal rate (37% on supplemental pay above $1 million in the year), plus 6.2% Social Security up to $184,500 of wages and 1.45% Medicare. On a $10,000 bonus with no state tax you take home about $7,035.
/us/pmi-calculator.html: Quick answer: PMI typically costs 0.3%–1.0% of the loan a year — about $30–$70 a month per $100,000 borrowed (Freddie Mac). On a $300,000 loan at 0.6% that is $150 a month. You can ask to cancel it at 80% loan-to-value, and it ends automatically at 78%.
/us/fire-calculator.html: Quick answer: Your FIRE number is 25 × your yearly spending at a 4% withdrawal rate — $1.25 million for $50,000 a year. Starting from zero at a 5% real return, saving 25% of take-home pay takes about 32 years; saving 50% takes about 17 years.
/us/benefits/ssi-benefit.html: Quick answer (2027): The federal SSI payment is $1,029 a month for an individual and $1,544 for a couple, after the 3.6% COLA. The first payment at the new rate is paid on December 31, 2026. Countable income reduces it after the $20 and $65 exclusions.
/uk/mortgage-affordability-calculator.ht: Quick answer: Most UK lenders lend about 4–4.5 times gross household income, some up to 5.5×, minus the effect of your debts. On £70,000 that is roughly £280,000–£315,000; £900 a month repays about £163,600 over 25 years at 4.4%.
/uk/pcp-car-finance-calculator.html: Quick answer: A PCP payment covers the car's expected depreciation plus interest on the whole amount, leaving a final balloon (GMFV). A £28,000 car with £3,000 down, an £11,000 balloon at 8.9% APR over 48 months costs about £424 a month, against £617 on HP. You can hand it back once you've paid half the total amount payable.
/uk/credit-card-repayment-calculator.htm: Quick answer: £3,500 at 24.9% APR takes 31 months to clear at £150 a month (about £1,142 interest) and 17 months at £250 a month. Paying only the minimum can take well over a decade.
/uk/pension-tax-relief-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026/27): Pension contributions get relief at your top income tax rate: 20% basic (added automatically), 40% higher and 45% additional (extra claimed via Self Assessment or HMRC). Between £100,000 and £125,140 the effective relief is 60% because you win back your personal allowance.
/uk/salary-to-hourly-calculator.html: Quick answer: Hourly rate = salary ÷ (weekly hours × 52). £30,000 a year is £15.38 an hour at 37.5 hours a week. The National Living Wage is £12.71 from April 2026 and rises to £13.21 from April 2027.
/uk/pro-rata-salary-calculator.html: Quick answer: Pro rata salary = full-time salary × your hours ÷ full-time hours. £36,000 pro rata for 22.5 of 37.5 hours is £21,600 a year (£1,800 a month), at the same hourly rate. Holiday is 5.6 weeks pro rata — 16.8 days for 3 days a week.
/ca/salary-after-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): A $75,000 salary in Ontario leaves about $56,926 a year ($4,744 a month) after federal and Ontario tax, CPP/CPP2 and EI. $100,000 leaves about $74,206 in Ontario, $75,373 in BC, $74,459 in Alberta and $69,585 in Quebec.
/ca/capital-gains-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Only 50% of a capital gain is taxable in Canada. With $80,000 of other income in Ontario, a $20,000 gain costs about $2,965 in tax (14.8% of the gain); the top effective rate is about 26.8%.
/es/calculadora-gasto-gasolina.html: Respuesta rápida: Coste = km × consumo (L/100 km) ÷ 100 × precio por litro. Un viaje de 500 km con 6 L/100 km y gasolina a 1,79 €/L cuesta unos 53,70 €. Precio medio en España (12/10/2026): 1,790 €/L gasolina 95 y 1,889 €/L diésel.
/au/fuel-cost-calculator.html: Quick answer: Fuel cost = km × L/100 km ÷ 100 × price per litre. A 500 km trip at 7 L/100 km and $2.34/L costs about $81.90. National averages around 7 November 2026: unleaded about 234.3 c/L, diesel about 278 c/L.
/zh/savings-goal-calculator.html: 快速答案：3 年存 10 万元，按年利率 1.25% 按月复利，每月约需存 2,727 元（不计利息为 2,778 元）。2026 年四大行三年期定期利率为 1.25%，一年期 0.95%。
/tw/labor-pension/labor-pension-account-: 快速答案：2026 年勞退月提繳工資最高 150,000 元（雇主 6% 每月最多 9,000 元），60 歲可請領。30 歲起、月提繳工資 60,800 元、年收益 3% 試算，60 歲只有雇主 6% 約 212.6 萬元，加上自提 6% 約 425.2 萬元。新制勞退基金 2025 年收益率 15.60%。
/uk/net-worth-calculator.html: Quick answer: net worth = everything you own minus everything you owe. The latest ONS figures (April 2020 – March 2022) put median household wealth in Great Britain at £293,700; the top 10% start at £1,200,500. With the default figures above, net worth is £102,400.
/br/calculadora-nota-enem-sisu.html: Resposta rápida: média do Sisu = soma de (nota × peso) ÷ soma dos pesos. Notas 640, 650, 600, 700 e 820 com pesos 1, 1, 2, 3 e 2 dão 692,22. O resultado do Enem 2026 sai em 18 de janeiro de 2027, segundo o Inep.
/uk/emergency-fund-calculator.html: Quick answer: MoneyHelper suggests keeping three to six months of essential outgoings in an instant-access account. With essentials of £2,000 a month that is £6,000–£12,000; savings are FSCS-protected up to £120,000 per person per authorised firm (2026).
/es/calculadora-consumo-electrico.html: Respuesta rápida: kWh = vatios ÷ 1.000 × horas. Un aparato de 1.000 W usado 3 horas al día gasta 90 kWh al mes: 13,50 € a 0,15 €/kWh. En 2026 la luz lleva el impuesto eléctrico (5,11269632 % ordinario) y el IVA (21 %, con rebajas temporales al 10 %).
/us/benefits/free-school-meals.html: Quick answer: for July 2026 – June 2027, a family of 4 qualifies for free school meals with income up to $42,900 a year ($3,575 a month) and for reduced-price meals up to $61,050 ($5,088 a month) in the 48 states and DC. Reduced-price lunch costs no more than 40¢.
/au/hourly-to-salary-calculator.html: Quick answer: annual salary = hourly rate × 38 hours × 52 weeks. $35 an hour is $69,160 a year ($2,660 a fortnight), about $56,509 after 2026-27 tax and Medicare. The national minimum wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 an hour ($1,004.90 a week).
/es/calculadora-nota-pau.html: Respuesta rápida: nota de acceso = 0,6 × Bachillerato + 0,4 × prueba (prueba ≥ 4 y resultado ≥ 5); nota de admisión = acceso + las dos mejores materias × 0,1 o 0,2, hasta 14. Con 8,2 y 7,1 la nota de acceso es 7,76. En Andalucía la PAU 2027 ordinaria es el 1, 2 y 3 de junio.
/uk/bonus-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026/27): There is no special bonus tax — a bonus is taxed as normal pay at 20%, 40% or 45% income tax plus 8% or 2% employee NI, and 9% student loan above your plan threshold (Scotland uses its own 19%–48% bands). On an £8,000 bonus with a £60,000 salary you keep £4,640 (58%); between £100,000 and £125,140 the effective rate is 60% + 2% NI.
/es/calculadora-finiquito.html: Respuesta rápida (2026): El finiquito en México suma sueldo pendiente, aguinaldo proporcional (15 días), vacaciones no gozadas y 25% de prima vacacional; si el despido es injustificado, la liquidación agrega 3 meses de salario y 12 días por año de prima de antigüedad (topada a 2 salarios mínimos, $630.08 diarios en 2026). Con $15,000 al mes y 5.5 años, el finiquito por renuncia es de unos $18,253 y la liquidación de unos $96,147.
/ca/cmhc-insurance-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): CMHC insurance costs 2.80%–4.00% of the mortgage when you put down less than 20% (4.00% with 5–9.99% down, 4.50% with a non-traditional down payment), plus 0.20% for a 30-year amortization. On a $500,000 home with 10% down the premium is $13,950, added to the loan; Ontario charges 8% retail sales tax on it at closing, and Quebec and Saskatchewan also tax it.
/en/korea-salary-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Korean employees pay National Pension 4.75% (9.5% total, rising 0.5 points a year), health insurance 3.595%, long-term care (13.14% of the health premium; 13.90% in 2027) and employment insurance 0.9%, plus income tax and 10% local tax. On a ₩42 million salary a single employee takes home about ₩3,040,718 a month in 2026 (about ₩3,033,077 in 2027).
/uk/fuel-cost-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Fuel cost = miles ÷ mpg × 4.546 litres × pump price. A 300-mile trip at 45 mpg uses 30.3 litres, which is £52.73 at £1.74 a litre (17.6p a mile; HMRC's December 2026 basis is petrol 174.1p and diesel 199.2p). Fuel duty is 52.95p a litre until at least 31 December 2026.
/uk/electricity-cost-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Running cost = watts ÷ 1,000 × hours × unit rate. Under Ofgem's price cap for 1 Oct–31 Dec 2026 the GB average is 26.32p per kWh (Direct Debit), so a 1,000 W appliance costs 26.3p an hour and a 2 kW heater for 4 hours a day costs £63.17 a month. The standing charge of 54.83p a day (about £200 a year) comes on top.
/uk/ltt-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): In Wales you pay no Land Transaction Tax up to £225,000, then 6% to £400,000, 7.5% to £750,000, 10% to £1.5m and 12% above. A £300,000 main home costs £4,500; second homes and buy-to-lets costing £40,000 or more pay higher rates of 5%–17% (£19,950 on £300,000).
/uk/overtime-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026/27): UK law sets no overtime rate — time and a half or double time applies only if your contract says so, but your average pay for all hours worked must stay at or above the minimum wage (£12.71 for 21+ from 1 April 2026, £13.21 from April 2027). Example: £14/hour × 37.5 hours + 6 hours at time and a half = £651 a week before tax.
/au/long-service-leave-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): In NSW, Queensland, WA and Tasmania you get 8.67 weeks of paid long service leave after 10 years with one employer; SA and the NT give 13 weeks after 10 years, and Victoria and the ACT give 6.07 weeks after 7 years. Leave keeps building at about 0.87 weeks a year (1.3 in SA and the NT), and a pro-rata payout can start after 5 or 7 years if you leave.
/au/savings-goal-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Monthly saving = what you still need ÷ months, a little less if your account pays interest. Saving $10,000 in a year takes about $833 a month ($814 at 5% interest), and a $100,000 house deposit in 5 years about $1,667 a month ($1,470 at 5%). Interest is taxable income, and deposits are protected up to $250,000 per bank.
/uk/shared-ownership-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): You buy a share of the home (usually 25%–75%, sometimes 10%) and pay rent on the rest – no more than 3% a year on new homes, typically 2.75%. On a £300,000 home with a 40% share, rent is £412.50 a month; with a 5% example mortgage and a £120 service charge the total is about £1,164 a month. Household income must be £80,000 or less (£90,000 in London).
/au/term-deposit-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026-27): At an example rate of 4.5% a year, $50,000 for 12 months earns $2,250 and $100,000 earns $4,500. Interest is taxed at your marginal rate plus the 2% Medicare levy in the year you receive it – on $85,000 income you keep $1,530 and $3,060. Deposits are protected up to $250,000 per account holder per bank by the Financial Claims Scheme.
/br/calculadora-consumo-energia.html: Resposta rápida (2026): kWh = watts ÷ 1.000 × horas de uso; custo = kWh × tarifa. Um chuveiro de 5.500 W usado 30 minutos por dia gasta 82,5 kWh por mês: R$ 74,25 com tarifa de exemplo de R$ 0,90 por kWh. Em novembro de 2026 a bandeira é verde; na vermelha patamar 2 a ANEEL soma R$ 7,877 a cada 100 kWh.
/fr/calcul-consommation-electrique.html: Réponse rapide (2026) : kWh = watts ÷ 1 000 × heures ; coût = kWh × prix du kWh. Depuis le 1er août 2026, le Tarif Bleu option Base coûte 0,2001 € TTC le kWh. Un radiateur de 2 000 W allumé 4 h par jour consomme 240 kWh par mois, soit 48,02 €.
/be/salaire-brut-net.html: Réponse rapide (2026) : pour un employé isolé sans enfant avec 7 % de taxe communale, 4 000 € brut donnent environ 2 659 € net par mois, et 3 000 € brut environ 2 189 € net. On retire 13,07 % d’ONSS, puis l’impôt (barème 25 à 50 %, quotité exemptée d’environ 11 550 € pour les revenus 2026) et la taxe communale.
/fr/smic-2026.html: Réponse rapide (2026) : depuis le 1er juin 2026, le SMIC est de 12,31 € brut de l’heure, soit 1 867,02 € brut et environ 1 477,93 € net par mois pour 35 heures. Il a augmenté de 2,41 % (il était de 12,02 € depuis le 1er janvier 2026).
/uk/isa-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026/27): you can pay up to £20,000 a year into ISAs, and interest, dividends and gains inside are tax-free. Budget 2026 kept the cash ISA limit at £20,000 from April 2027 (the planned cut to £12,000 was reversed). £500 a month at 5% grows to about £77,641 in 10 years.
/us/benefits/earned-income-tax-credit-gu: Quick answer: for tax year 2026 the EITC is worth up to $8,231 (3+ children), $7,316 (2), $4,427 (1) or $664 (none). A single filer with two children must earn under $58,629 ($65,899 married filing jointly). For 2025 returns filed in 2026 the maximum is $8,046.
/au/bonus-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026-27): a bonus is taxed as ordinary income at your marginal rate plus the 2% Medicare levy. On a $90,000 salary a $10,000 bonus costs about $3,200 in tax (32%), so you keep $6,800. Your employer can withhold at most 47% of a bonus; your tax return settles the difference.
/ie/savings-goal-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): monthly saving = what you still need ÷ months, a little less with interest. €10,000 in 2 years takes about €417 a month (€410 at 2.5% after 33% DIRT). Bank interest loses 33% DIRT; State Savings are tax-free, and deposits are protected up to €100,000 per bank.
/uk/50-30-20-budget-calculator.html: Quick answer: the 50/30/20 rule splits take-home pay into 50% needs, 30% wants and 20% savings. On £3,200 a month that is £1,600, £960 and £640. On a £30,000 salary (about £2,093 a month after 2026/27 tax and NI) it is £1,047, £628 and £419.
/uk/rent-affordability-calculator.html: Quick answer: MoneyHelper's guide is to spend up to 30% of your income before tax on rent: on £40,000 that is £1,000 a month. Many agents also check that income is at least 30× the monthly rent. In England deposits are capped at 5 weeks' rent and, since 1 May 2026, rent in advance at 1 month.
/uk/savings-goal-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): monthly saving = what you still need ÷ months, a little less with interest. £10,000 in 2 years takes about £417 a month (£401 at 4% interest); a £30,000 house deposit in 5 years about £500 a month (£452 at 4%). Most savers pay no tax on interest, and savings are FSCS-protected up to £120,000.
/uk/tax-free-childcare-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): for every £8 you pay into a Tax-Free Childcare account the government adds £2 – a 20% top-up, up to £500 every 3 months (£2,000 a year) per child, or £1,000 / £4,000 for a disabled child. A £9,000 nursery bill gets £1,800, and you reach the full £2,000 at a £10,000 bill. Each parent must expect to earn at least £2,643.68 over the next 3 months (age 21+) and neither of you can expect over £100,000.
/uk/child-benefit-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026/27): Child Benefit is £27.05 a week for the eldest child and £17.90 for each other child – £1,407 a year for one child, £2,337 for two. If the higher earner's adjusted net income is over £60,000, 1% is paid back for every £200 above it, so all of it goes at £80,000.
/ca/fhsa-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): you can put $8,000 a year into an FHSA, up to $40,000 for life, and up to $8,000 of unused room carries forward. An $8,000 contribution at $70,000 income saves about $2,372 in tax in Ontario ($2,440 in Alberta, $2,889 in Quebec), and money taken out for a qualifying first home is tax-free.
/ca/gic-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): $20,000 in a 3-year GIC at 3.5% (compounded yearly) grows to $22,174.36, and $10,000 at 3% for 1 year earns $300. In a regular account the interest is taxed every year at your marginal rate (about $645 of that $2,174 in Ontario at $70,000 income); in a TFSA it is tax-free. CDIC insures up to $100,000 per category at each member bank.
/au/fhss-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Under the First Home Super Saver scheme you can put up to $15,000 from any one financial year ($50,000 in total) of voluntary contributions into super and later have 85% of before-tax contributions plus associated earnings released for a first home. Earnings are worked out at the ATO shortfall interest charge rate, 7.51% a year for October to December 2026, and the ATO withholds your expected marginal rate minus a 30% offset (or 17%). On a $90,000 salary, $15,000 a year for 3 years pays out about $43,400 against about $32,300 saved in a bank at 4%.
/uk/savings-interest-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): In 2026/27 basic-rate taxpayers can earn £1,000 of savings interest tax-free, higher-rate taxpayers £500 and additional-rate taxpayers £0, plus up to £5,000 at 0% if other taxable income is under £17,570. Interest above that is taxed at 20%, 40% or 45% – rising to 24%, 44% and 49% from 6 April 2027. Example: £2,400 of interest on a £35,000 salary costs £280 now and £336 from April 2027.
/es/root-exponent-calculator.html: Respuesta rápida (2026): para simplificar una raíz cuadrada, saca fuera el mayor cuadrado perfecto: √72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2 ≈ 8,4853. Un exponente fraccionario es una raíz: 8^(2/3) = (∛8)² = 4, y un logaritmo pregunta a qué número elevas la base: log₂(8) = 3.
/us/benefits/head-start.html: Quick answer (2026): a child qualifies for free Head Start if family income is at or below the 2026 poverty line — $27,320 a year for a family of 3, $33,000 for 4 ($15,960 + $5,680 per extra person, 48 states and DC; Alaska and Hawaii are higher) — or if the family is on public assistance, is homeless, or the child is in foster care. Families up to 130% of the line ($35,516 for 3) may get a place if the program has room.
/au/super-co-contribution-calculator.htm: Quick answer (2026-27): the government adds 50 cents for every $1 you put into super after tax, up to $500, if your total income is $49,293 or less; it falls to $0 at $64,293. At $55,000 income the most you can get is about $310. Earn $37,000 or less and LISTO can also refund up to $500 of the tax on your before-tax super.
/sg/retirement-savings-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): divide your yearly retirement spending by your withdrawal rate. With the 4% rule, $36,000 a year needs $900,000; if CPF LIFE pays you $1,500 a month, you only need $450,000. CPF LIFE payouts can start from 65.
/au/net-worth-calculator.html: Quick answer: net worth = everything you own − everything you owe. $510,500 of assets (home, super, savings, car) minus $318,000 of debts (mortgage, loans, cards) = $192,500. Count super and your HELP debt, and use today's values.
/nl/root-exponent-calculator.html: Snel antwoord: een wortel vereenvoudig je door het grootste kwadraat eruit te halen: √72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2 ≈ 8,4853. Een gebroken exponent is een wortel: 8^(2/3) = (∛8)² = 4, en een negatieve exponent geeft het omgekeerde: 2^(−3) = 0,125.
/nl/spaardoel-berekenen.html: Snel antwoord (2026): bedrag per maand = wat nog ontbreekt ÷ aantal maanden, iets minder met rente. € 10.000 in 2 jaar vraagt € 417 per maand (€ 407 bij 2,5% rente); € 40.000 in 5 jaar ongeveer € 667 per maand (€ 627 bij 2,5%).
/nl/stroomverbruik-berekenen.html: Snel antwoord: kWh = vermogen in watt ÷ 1.000 × uren. Een apparaat van 1.000 W dat 3 uur per dag aanstaat, gebruikt 3 kWh per dag; bij € 0,30 per kWh is dat € 27 per maand en ongeveer € 329 per jaar. Stand-by van 5 W kost zo’n € 13 per jaar.
/de/zinseszins-rechner.html: Kurz gesagt (2026): 200 € im Monat werden bei 5 % Zins in 20 Jahren zu rund 81.161 € – eingezahlt sind nur 48.000 €. Mit 5.000 € Startkapital sind es rund 94.427 €. Bei 4 % verdoppelt sich Geld in etwa 18 Jahren (Werte vor Steuern und Kosten).
/fr/calcul-objectif-epargne.html: Réponse rapide (2026) : à épargner par mois = ce qu’il vous manque ÷ nombre de mois, un peu moins avec des intérêts. Pour 10 000 € en 2 ans, comptez 417 € par mois sans intérêts, ou 409 € avec un placement à 2 % par an (taux d’exemple).
/co/calculadora-gasto-gasolina.html: Respuesta rápida (2026): galones = kilómetros ÷ rendimiento (km por galón), y costo = galones × precio del galón. Un viaje de 500 km en un carro que hace 40 km/gal gasta 12,5 galones: con un galón de ejemplo a $16.000 son $200.000, o $100.000 por persona si viajan dos. En noviembre de 2026 el Gobierno mantuvo estables los precios de referencia de la gasolina corriente.
/nz/fuel-cost-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): fuel cost = km × L/100 km ÷ 100 × price a litre. Auckland to Wellington (640 km) at 7 L/100 km and $2.60 a litre (example price) costs about $116.48 one way, $232.96 return. Diesel cars and EVs also pay road user charges: the standard light-vehicle rate is $76 per 1,000 km.
/it/calcolo-costo-carburante.html: Risposta rapida (2026): costo = km × consumo (L/100 km) ÷ 100 × prezzo al litro. Milano–Roma (575 km) con un'auto da 6,5 L/100 km e benzina a 1,95 €/l (prezzo di esempio) costa circa 72,88 € solo andata, 145,76 € andata e ritorno. Usa il prezzo che paghi al distributore.
